ios.desc:
Turn ideas into cinematic videos in seconds

Reel AI is the next-generation AI video generator that transforms text or images into cinematic motion clips. It’s built for creators, brands, and anyone who wants to make short videos quickly and easily.

Create in seconds

• Text to Video: Type your idea and watch AI bring it to life.
• Image to Video: Animate photos with depth and cinematic movement.
• Photo to Video: Turn portraits, cars, or interiors into dynamic motion shots.
• AI Styles: Choose from cinematic, anime, fantasy, ASMR, and more.

Professional results with zero effort

Reel AI helps you make short, share-ready videos without editing experience. Combine multiple AI styles for unique results and export HD videos optimized for all social platforms.

Built with advanced AI video technology

Reel AI uses the latest models to deliver realistic lighting, motion, and camera dynamics. Every generation feels natural, emotional, and shareable.

Perfect for

• Content creators and storytellers
• Businesses and marketers
• Artists exploring new visual formats
• Anyone looking to make AI videos fast

Subscriptions

• Weekly Plan – $6.99: Full access with credits
• Yearly Plan – $49.99: Save 60% compared to weekly

Manage or cancel anytime in Account Settings.

Download AI Video Maker – Reel AI and turn your imagination into cinematic motion.

quotes.text:
Hey HN,

We just released AI Video Generator: aiVideo — an iOS app by Virtual Minds that lets you create short, cinematic videos directly from text or images using multiple top-tier AI video models under one subscription.

App Store link: https://apps.apple.com/rs/app/ai-video-generator-aivideo/id6736862905

What it does:

Converts prompts or photos into cinematic, share-ready clips in seconds

Access to multiple generation engines — Sora 2, Veo 3, Wan, Kling, and others

Seamless model switching and comparison in one interface

Exports directly to the Photos app

Under the hood:

Built in React Native + UIKit, optimized for iOS

Prompt routing and model orchestration handled via Firebase Functions

Server-side generation with latency optimization and adaptive credit usage

Designed for creators who want to experiment with multiple models natively, without browser UIs

We built it to test the limits of mobile-first AI generation — from latency, UX flow, to model integration.

Would love feedback on:

Model orchestration strategies — what would you improve?

Whether an open API for developers to run model calls from mobile makes sense

Thoughts on latency vs quality trade-offs for multimodel routing

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/rs/app/ai-video-generator-aivideo/id6736862905

— Virtual Minds Team
